# fjordrun_shared_variables (Data Source)

An environment's shared variables: as set (`variables`), and resolved (`resolved`). All sensitive. Needs the member role: for a viewer's token it is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_shared_variables" "production" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `resolved` (Map of String, Sensitive) With references resolved.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) As set.
